blocks.content: A walk is a route from a starting vertex to an end vertex. In a walk, you can have repeated vertices and repeated edges.

blocks.alt: Walk From Start to End Vertex

blocks.content: In the above figure, 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3 is a walk.
The number of edges encountered during a walk is called the length of a walk.
Let's look at one more example of a walk.
